title: Dark Predictions Paintings — remove auctions, add contact-email purchase flow, and admin painting management

requirements.text: Remove the auction/bidding feature entirely, including any auction navigation, pages, backend endpoints, data models, and UI copy that references auctions, bidding, or user registration for bidding.

quotes: Ok cut out the auction part and list my email instead for users to email me to buy. “offgridsecrets@gmail.com” and same email for admin dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: There is no auction/bidding section visible anywhere in the UI (no routes, menus, buttons, or labels).
Backend has no auction/bid-related types, state, or public methods.
No user registration flow for bidding exists.

requirements.text: Implement a purchase/contact flow based on a displayed email address: show the contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" on all public painting listing pages and painting detail pages, including a clear call-to-action link using a mailto: link.

quotes: list my email instead for users to email me to buy. “offgridsecrets@gmail.com”

acceptanceCriteria: Every painting card and/or painting detail view displays "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" as the contact email for purchases.
The email is clickable and opens the user’s email client via a mailto: link.
User-facing text is in English and does not mention auctions/bidding.

requirements.text: Build the core public gallery for the site titled "Dark Predictions Paintings": a home/gallery page that lists all paintings for sale, and a detail view per painting showing image(s), title, description, and price, plus the purchase contact email.
acceptanceCriteria: The site displays the title "Dark Predictions Paintings" prominently (e.g., header and browser title).
A public gallery view lists paintings pulled from the backend.
A painting detail view exists and shows title, description, price, and image(s).

requirements.text: Implement an admin dashboard that allows the admin to create, edit, and delete painting listings with fields: title, description, price, and image(s). The dashboard must display the admin contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" in the admin UI.

quotes: admin dashboard that allows me the ability to upload , title and describe and price each painting.
and same email for admin dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a new painting with title, description, price, and at least one image.
Admin can edit title/description/price/images for an existing painting.
Admin can delete an existing painting.
The admin dashboard UI shows "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" (as a displayed contact/admin email).

requirements.text: Add a mission statement section on the public site stating that proceeds support building and developing affordable modern housing for the local community.

quotes: and the money raised is going to build and develop affordable modern housing for my local community.

acceptanceCriteria: A visible mission statement is present on the public site in English and clearly communicates the proceeds’ purpose.

requirements.text: Add authentication for accessing the admin dashboard using Internet Identity (no email-based login). Restrict all admin-only backend methods (create/update/delete paintings) so they can only be called by authenticated admin identity/identities configured for the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin routes/pages require Internet Identity login to access.
Non-admin users cannot call create/update/delete painting methods (backend enforces authorization).
The app does not implement email-based authentication, registration, verification, or emailing features.

requirements.text: Create and apply a cohesive visual theme suitable for a premium, one-of-a-kind painting gallery (consistent typography, spacing, and color system). Use a distinct style (e.g., dark editorial/noir gallery aesthetic) and apply it consistently across the public site and admin dashboard; do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

quotes: Make me a million dollar design and function website

acceptanceCriteria: Public pages and admin pages share a consistent design system (colors, type scale, components).
Primary palette avoids blue/purple as the dominant brand colors.
Design feels gallery/premium and is consistently applied across navigation, cards, and forms.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).

Do not modify files under frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui); compose/consume them instead.
Do not implement email-based authentication/registration or any email-sending functionality; only display the provided email address as text/link.
nonGoals: Payment processing/checkout (e.g., Stripe) is out of scope.
Shipping, tax calculation, or order management workflows are out of scope.
User accounts, profiles, wishlists, or bidding/auction mechanics are out of scope.

required: Minimalist wordmark logo on transparent background, dark editorial style (dark-predictions-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png)
Abstract dark textured hero background suitable for an art gallery landing section (gallery-hero-texture.dim_2400x1350.png)

preferencesToAdd: User-facing text should be in English.
miscToAdd: Admin/purchase contact email to display: offgridsecrets@gmail.com
